company.name: Wafeq
company.shortDescription: Wafeq is a software that provides accounting and e-invoicing solutions for business owners and accountants.
company.description: Wafeq is a software that sends invoices, quotes, purchases orders, manages inventory and payroll, and generates financial reports to help owners and accountants run the business efficiently. Wafeq generates VAT returns automatically.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based software for managing accounting, invoicing, purchase orders, inventory, payroll, and financial reporting for businesses and accountants.

productsAndServices.description: A module to manage employee payroll processing and streamline employee expense claims within the accounting system.
productsAndServices.name: Payroll and Employee Expense Management

productsAndServices.description: Automated generation of VAT returns formatted according to tax authority requirements for easy submission.
productsAndServices.name: VAT Return Automation

productsAndServices.description: Automatic tracking and management of product and service inventory linked to invoicing and sales.
productsAndServices.name: Inventory and Product/Service Management

productsAndServices.description: A contact management system to maintain and use lists of customers and suppliers for invoicing and purchasing.
productsAndServices.name: Supplier and Customer Contact Management

productsAndServices.description: Generation of comprehensive financial reports including profit and loss, cash flow forecasts, sales, purchases, and consolidated statements.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Reporting and Analytics

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $7,500,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,377,048 to $49,377,958, a 7.74x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 88 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Xero, Zoho, QuickBooks.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
